run.description: Add the source a file declares, or replace the one of its name
does: it adds one source and copies no command files, and changes nothing else. It grants no call, makes no hook, and sets no credential's file.
source numeric: its calls go to https://example.invalid. It names no credential.
call create (update): POST /items. It takes no parameter, and sends no query.
call create sends the body {"count":16}. Its answer is returned as it comes, at most 65536 bytes.

it has no check call, no idempotency header, no way to tell a user, no way to hear deliveries, no limits command, no way to speak in threads, no bead link, no identity fold (its identity keys keep their case), no hook deliveries into the yard and no pull-request or CI events.

carried.name: numeric
carried.text:
name: numeric
base: https://example.invalid
calls:
  create:
    kind: update
    request: {method: POST, path: /items, body: {count: 0x10}}
